caption: The drawing depicts a single candle holder with a conical base and a wide-bottomed circular tray. The candle holder is predominantly dark in color, with decorative patterns painted on it. The central body features large red flowers with green leaves, accented by small yellow and orange details. The top of the holder, where the candle is placed, is cylindrical and also has a band of red floral and swirl patterns on a dark background. Two yellow horizontal stripes are painted around the narrow upper part of the holder, just below the candle cup. The base of the cone is encircled by a yellow band, and the circular tray at the bottom appears dark with some lighter shading to indicate reflections or light. The background of the drawing is plain, with no additional objects, and the artist’s signature "Jobini Hael" is visible on the lower right corner.
title: Toleware Candlestick
